svg.title: Index Translator server components, sentences and web pages
svg.desc: The app asks the segmentation engine for sentence ends and for paragraph or sentence alignment. The engine starts its worker thread on the first request. The thread runs SaT for sentence ends on sat.wasm, a hand-written WebAssembly forward pass whose helper Workers share its memory, and LaBSE for the embeddings that the alignment step matches, on libllama's CPU backend through the bindings file. The alignment step is the dynamic programme of the AIlign paper. A web page is opened by its own module in a headless browser, and a script that runs inside the page turns it into Markdown. The two share nothing but the process. sentence ends: src/app.ts → src/segment.ts → src/segment-worker.ts → src/sat.ts → src/sat-wasm.ts. alignment embeddings: src/app.ts → src/segment.ts → src/segment-worker.ts → src/labse.ts → src/llama-embed-ffi.ts → libllama. a web page: src/app.ts → src/webpage.ts → src/page/extract.ts.

g.text: allowed hosts, one view per fetch
